record_title: The full support-function Hessian of the uncentered Gaussian Santaló product
limitations: The result determines the complete second variation at the unit ball but does not settle the global maximization problem for n>=3 in 1/n<sigma^2<=2/(n+1). Strict Hessian negativity is stated as directional second-order stability rather than a topology-uniform neighborhood theorem. At the critical variance the fourth-order calculation is only along actual translations, not a complete fourth-order normal form. The motivating preprint is very recent, so later revisions or unindexed parallel calculations remain a residual originality risk.
